description: Official Swiss company check from the Zefix register (Central Business Name Index, federal). Look up by UID (exact, e.g. CHE-105.909.036) or search by name (up to 5 candidates). Returns official name with translations, legal form, register status (active / in liquidation / deleted) with deletion date, legal seat, purpose, address and last SHAB publication date, with a direct link to the cantonal register excerpt. Companies only.

name.description: Company name to search (up to 5 candidates)

uid.description: Swiss UID (exact), e.g. CHE-105.909.036; provide this or 'name'
